scope: GL genotype-likelihood ordering and the VCFv4.5 VCF5.5 illustrative ordering matrix. This does not cover every GT/FORMAT semantic.

VCFv4_1.finding: GL uses canonical genotype order; without GT, diploidy is assumed. It defines F(j/k)=(k*(k+1)/2)+j and gives diploid biallelic/triallelic examples. GLE is separately defined for heterogeneous ploidy under uncertain copy number.

VCFv4_2.finding: Same GL diploid ordering formula and GLE heterogeneous-ploidy field as VCFv4.1.

VCFv4_3.finding: GLE is removed (change log: unused and ill-defined). GL retains same-ploidy expectation with diploidy assumed without GT. A general ploidy P/N ordering algorithm is introduced: nested inclusive loops, recursive equivalent and combinatorial genotype-index formula.

VCFv4_4.finding: The general-ploidy algorithm, recursive equivalent and combinatorial index are retained. GLE remains removed.

VCFv4_5.finding: The same general-ploidy algorithm is retained. VCF5.5 is a diploid triangular-matrix illustration; the normative algorithm is the surrounding prose/pseudocode and inclusive-loop footnote, not the matrix alone.

changes: Remove GLE heterogeneous-ploidy FORMAT tag as unused/ill-defined.
Introduce general-ploidy GL genotype ordering algorithm and combinatorial index.
Retain same-ploidy expectation with GT and diploidy assumption when GT absent.

normative_algorithm_clauses.finding: General ploidy P and N alternate alleles; allele values are nondecreasing in the canonical ordering.
Nested loops are used with as many levels as ploidy; inclusive for-loop boundaries are explicitly stated in a footnote.
Recursive algorithm is stated as an equivalent method.
Combinatorial index formula maps a nondecreasing genotype allele tuple to its likelihood-array index.
Illustrative triangular matrix for P=2; does not replace the general algorithm.

remaining: Independent reviewer must verify the algorithm's exact mathematical equivalence, loop boundaries and index formula.
Map Number=G cardinality and GL/PL/GP requirements to atomic ledger IDs for each version.
Add executable conformance tests for haploid, diploid, triploid and higher ploidy with multiple alternate alleles, including boundary and missing-GT cases.
No implementation or test execution is claimed.
